title: Lowleaf Hollow - Deep Glimmer
_note: Option C richer-register / explore-light variant. era GBA (Option C only) - up to 8 voices, chords allowed, warm reverb; the 'breathy pad' is now a real sustaining pad. 90bpm, 4/4, Lydian-tinged G major (raised 4th C#). Glassy bell lead; shimmering bell arpeggio; a faint second counter-bell answering the spine a bar late and a fifth up; a real warm pad chord sustaining underneath; warm sustained low pad-bass; sparse soft taps + a gentle dew-shimmer swell. Vesper: same Lydian ascent as A (lift D4->G4->A4, settle B4->A4->G4, overshoot stretched by the #4 C#) - the counter-bell echoes the spine a bar late and a fifth up, the motif heard as glimmers answering across the dark. 24-bar loop, voice-leads home. Rendered on chip engine per house style.
